class.name: CbItemBody
class.brief_description: What the server knows about an item, authored in the item's scene: its body when it lies in the world, and named numbers.
class.description: A [BoxShape3D] or a [SphereShape3D], placed where the shape's centre is from the grip (the scene's origin), unrotated. Baking writes it and [member properties] to [code]items/<kind>.cfg[/code] (the Bake button here, or [code]bake_items.gd[/code]; publishing a mod runs it), which the server reads from the mod's item. In the game the node does nothing: the simulation owns the physics.

method.name: bake_to_project
method.description: What the Bake button does: writes [code]res://items/<kind>.cfg[/code] for every kind whose [CbItemLook] (in [code]res://vfx/reactions*.tscn[/code]) draws this scene. Save the scene first. Servers get it when the mod is published.

method.name: bake
method.description: The baked text: [code]{ text, error }[/code] ([code]text[/code] is empty when the shape cannot be baked).

members.member: Named numbers about the item that any server mod may read, e.g. [code]pickup.hold_seconds[/code] = 0.5 (hold E that long to pick it up). They replace what the item's mod declared in code for the same names.
